sentences.text:
Applicant :- Archana Pandey
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Yaseen,Budhi Ram Gupta

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the
record.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court below for
early disposal of Complaint Case no.439 of 2017 (Old Case no.7305/2016) under Sections- 498A,
323, 504, 506 Ipc and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Sarnath District Varanasi.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station Sarnath District Varanasi
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the aforesaid matter is pending till date,
no final decision has been taken.

Prayer has been made to direct the court below to pass appropriate Archana Pandey vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51310852/
1 orders expeditiously.

entities.text: Archana Pandey vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA has no objection to the aforesaid prayer as made by learned counsel for the applicant.
5. In view of the order proposed to be passed herein, no useful purpose would be served by putting the opposite party to notice and keeping this application pending before this Court.
However, in case the opposite party feels aggrieved by the order his/her right to seek modification/variation of the order is being kept reserved.

6. Considering the fact and circumstances and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
